dataSource: City of Pittsburgh PLI Permits (WPRDC CKAN dataset), queried live

coverage.type: Building, electrical, mechanical, and related permits

notes: Pulled live from the WPRDC open data portal on every search, not a static extract — coverage reflects whatever the city has published as of your search.
Since June 2024, building permits are recorded as "Building & Development Application" rather than "Building".
Plumbing permits are not included here — Allegheny County Health Department handles those separately from the city.
Matched by a full-text search plus house-number filter; results may occasionally miss or include unrelated records for uncommon address formats.
summary: Pittsburgh is covered by a live query against the city's public PLI Permits dataset, matched by address as you search.
